description: Change the name or description of an existing port mapping on a specific instance (by id or exact name). The internal and public ports cannot be changed. To change them, delete the mapping and add a new one. Game-required ports cannot be edited at all. Call get_connection_info first to see the current mappings. Port mappings apply to shared-IP servers only.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set this only after showing the user exactly what will be changed, naming the internal port it applies to and getting their approval.

container.description: The internal port of the mapping to change, from get_connection_info.

description.description: New description for the mapping. Pass an empty string to clear it.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

name: update_port
title: Update Port Mapping
